summary: Macerich Co filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of 19,200,000 shares of common stock at $21.00 per share, with an underwriter option for an additional 2,880,000 shares. The offering is a follow-on equity raise under an existing shelf registration, netting approximately $390 million before expenses. The stock trades on NYSE under MAC; last sale $21.87 on May 8, 2026. Joint bookrunners include Goldman Sachs, Deutsche Bank, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, and others. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation; the proceeds are for general corporate purposes, and there are no explicit terms for an acquisition, divestiture, or other event-driven category.
